9: export class ApiClient {

11: 
12:   async request<T>(options: RequestOptions): Promise<T> {
13:     let attempt = 0;
14:     for (;;) {
15:       try {
16:         const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${options.path}`, {
17:           method: options.method ?? 'GET',
18:         });
19:         if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`http ${response.status}`);
20:         return (await response.json()) as T;
21:       } catch (err) {
22:         attempt += 1;
23:         if (!shouldRetry(attempt, this.policy)) throw err;
24:         await sleep(this.policy.backoffMs(attempt));
25:       }
26:     }
27:   }
28: }
